description: Every accepted answer to all 7 daily Krillion prompts, by rarity tier, for each day 2026-09-25 through 2026-11-13 inclusive (dives #72-#121).
game_note: Krillion (krillion.io) publishes one dive per day at midnight America/New_York. Dive #121 (2026-11-13) was still live at extraction time.

sources.thewordfinder.com: Days 2026-10-28 to 2026-11-13 (its archive starts Oct 28). Primary, user-supplied source. Also provides most_common_player_answers (what players typed most, with the tier each earned) for finished days.
sources.krillion.run: Days 2026-09-25 to 2026-10-27 (thewordfinder has no sheets that far back). Also supplied proper casing/spacing for One-in-a-Krillion answers on thewordfinder days, whose tile UI reveals only capital letters. Answer lists cross-checked identical on 2026-10-28 and 2026-11-12.
sources.krillionarchive.com: Supplied proper casing/spacing and the multi-gem split for 2026-11-03 gems (krillion.run has no sheet that date); cross-checked against krillionanswers.org.

caveats: thewordfinder.com archive begins 2026-10-28, so the first 33 of the 50 days come from krillion.run's archive instead.
2026-11-13 is the live dive; its sheet may be updated later in the day, and it has no most_common_player_answers yet.
times_typed values are the site's rounded display figures (e.g. 307.6K).
Prompts can have more than one One-in-a-Krillion gem (e.g. 2026-11-03 'Name any Pokemon' has Binacle and Mothim); gem counts vary by day.
